name: swapy-handle
title: Swapy Handle Bento Grid
blurb: Draggable bento grid with visual drag handles.
description: A 12-column draggable grid using Swapy with DragHandle components visible on cards. Cards have emojis and titles; drag-to-rearrange with visual feedback.
use_when: Customizable dashboards or widget grids where drag-handle UI explicitly invites reordering.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces where drag handles could be small targets or where reordering isn't needed.
a11y: Drag handles are interactive elements; keyboard support depends on Swapy library. Visual handles clarify draggability.
